name: BACH_0073_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with tumor called at all four margins; stains blocked for frozen sections.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% [F1] | All weight on invasive carcinoma |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC despite stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Two independent foundation models match |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (100%, similarity 0.74–0.83) [F5] | All nearest neighbors are invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score (1.56, +1.86 contribution) strongly supports stromal invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 2, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (2.03, +1.19), but 0/20 AI spot check is unreliable [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.25, +0.93 contribution); scarce tubules favor invasion [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.99, +0.90 contribution); scarce benign stroma favors invasion · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Elevated atypia score (2.05, +0.65 contribution) supports invasive read · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) by 0.0114 over random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion difference 0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 simulated frozen-section stain degradation (100% OOD percentile) mimics invasion; reliability ranks frozen-section errors at 70% AUROC.
- Tumor is duct-confined in situ carcinoma, like contrast case BACH_0046 (InSitu, 66% similarity, differing in duct_confined and benign_stroma_fat).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 8, 9, 11**: Confirm true stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism rather than severity-3 stain artifact.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 7, 11**: Manually verify mitotic figures (unreliable 0/20 concept) and absent tubules in region 7.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Verify tumor at superior (538 um), inferior (860 um), medial (430 um), lateral (645 um) margins [F7].
